propositions: git commit --amend -F/-m drops the Change-Id trailer, causing Gerrit to stamp a fresh one and create a duplicate change instead of a new patchset
A git hook cannot detect the difference between an amend with -F and a fresh commit with -F, so hook-based guards are ineffective
Major Gerrit projects (Go, OpenStack, Android, Chromium) solve this by providing wrapper commands that preserve Change-Id during amend, making the failure unreachable rather than detectable
The make amend-msg wrapper must amend HEAD with file contents while carrying forward the existing Change-Id, and fail loudly if HEAD has no Change-Id
AGENTS.md documentation must be updated to name make amend-msg as the correct path for rewritten commit messages and warn that --amend -m/-F create duplicate changes
